Name: Dinosaur Horse Replacer
Author: Vooboo1
Description:
Replaces your horse texture with a ferocious dinosaur! Fully animated and ready to instill fear into your enemies.

This is my third animation ever made, and most time spent on it was for the side strafe animation. I'm still learning how to get better at pixel art and animation, so if anyone has some constructive criticism feel free to lay it on me! <3

Downloads.Description: Rideable dinosaur mount with blood drip animation.
